name: Xuzhou Open AM 2021
information: Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Xuzhou Open AM 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Xuzhou-Open-AM-2021)** and **[Xuzhou Open PM 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Xuzhou-Open-PM-2021)**, in two half-days respectively.
